### Upstage – Overview **Company** – Upstage (formerly “Upstage AI”) is a Korean‑founded AI startup, headquartered in Seoul. It was launched in 2020 by a team of researchers and engineers who have deep experience in large‑scale language‑model development (e.g., the ChatGPT paper co‑author Kim Seong‑hoon). **Mission** – “Bring AI technology to the front stage and create real‑world value across many industries.” **Core Expertise** – Large language models (LLM), multimodal AI, document‑understanding (OCR + KIE), and enterprise‑grade APIs. --- ## 1. Flagship Products | Product | What it does | Key Highlights | |---------|--------------|----------------| | **Solar LLM series** | Generates, summarizes, translates, writes code, and answers questions. Available in two families:
  • **Solar Open 100B** – 100 billion‑parameter model released in Q2 2024.
  • **Solar Pro 3** – 30 billion‑parameter model released in late 2023, optimized for fast response and low‑cost inference.
| • Strong Korean‑language ability (state‑of‑the‑art for Korean).
• High performance on English and Japanese benchmarks.
• Available as a public API (Solar API) and as on‑premise/private‑cloud deployments. | | **Solar API** | One‑stop REST/HTTP endpoint that bundles text‑generation, summarization, translation, code‑assistant, and a “document‑in‑context” module that takes OCR‑derived text and runs it through the LLM. | • Adjustable temperature, top‑p, and stop‑token settings.
• Built‑in prompt templates for common use‑cases (e.g., “Chat‑bot”, “Document QA”). | | **Document AI (OCR + KIE)** | Turns scanned PDFs, photos, and handwritten pages into searchable, structured data.
  • **OCR** – high‑precision character recognition, table detection, multi‑language support.
  • **KIE** – extracts key information such as dates, amounts, parties, clause IDs, and
